items.title: Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence for a cover by two open subsets

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence 0 -> H^0(X, F) -> H^0(U, F) plus H^0(V, F) -> H^0(U cap V, F) -> H^1(X, F) -> ... for a ringed space covered by two open subsets, with functoriality in F (statement lines 768-778). The proof does not chase the sequence directly; it assembles a short exact sequence of complexes of sections of an injective resolution, where the two required properties come from different places: the kernel part is the sheaf condition, and the surjectivity part is the separate lemma that restriction of an injective module to an open is surjective (proof lines 782-797). The author explicitly leaves the functoriality unproved, and that sentence is reproduced as written. The claim is H2: one assembly of two cited facts into an exact sequence of complexes.
